desc: The NEW CARBON RAZOR rimfire rifle is available in .22 LR and .17 HMR calibers. The Razor features the same high quality components as the other Fierce models: Dedicated rimfire carbon fiber stock, C3 Carbon Fiber barrel, and Precision machined stainless steel action. Caliber Conversion kits available. One Razor rimfire will provide .22 LR or .17 HRM capability. Two colors available: Black action – Forest stock | Glacier action – Phantom stock
